Not re-run: the 2.0.15 re-verification already showed the release route returns 500 after the mapping passes validation (backend-repro-20260918 HANDOVER); the 2.0.16 change only adds expected_destination_c_type to each mapping item and is covered by unit tests.

Not re-run: needs a live publish-to-database export to patch, which the release workspace does not have; the 2.0.16 change only corrects the example value shape. Backend response to the corrected shape was recorded in reverify-215-20260918.

argv: mammoth view transform set-values 84 --project 29 --profile release --output json --no-input --input '{"dataset_id": 63, "existing_column": "amount", "values": [{"value": "0"}], "condition": {"column": "amount", "operator": "IS_EMPTY"}}'
detail: With SDK 0.7.9 only the blank amount row became 0 (view data get: A=$1,234.56, B=0, C=10, D=$7,000). With SDK <=0.7.8 the same call set every row: the task-level CONDITION is ignored by the backend's VERSION 2 VALUES form (observed in the Haiku cold-start run as all amounts 0 and all regions Unknown). The condition is now folded into each value item.
